q2_gaps: Inchoative aspectual verb whose SUBJECT is the eventuality, with no verbal complement ('a shoreline survey begins at dawn'): the Inception section specifies only the complement frames 'began / started / commenced to V' and 'started V-ing', so it is unspecified (a) whether to reify a separate begin event at all, versus attaching an interval (Start <event-noun-witness> dawn) to the event-noun per Intervals or collapsing onto the event-noun as the light-verb rule does for occurred / happened / took place, and (b) which role the eventive subject then takes — Patient by the intransitive change-of-state test versus Theme, the role the Inception section itself assigns to the activity.
notes: The absent tense atom is exactly what the instruction set prescribes: 'the survey begins at dawn' is its own worked example of a bare present with an unanchored adjunct, which gets no status atom. The Inception section's Ongoing marker on the activity is correctly not emitted, since an unmarked present asserts no occurrence for the survey to be underway.
